item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Rachna studies the diagram of triangles $ABC$ and $STU$. Each angle of $ABC$ equals the matching angle of $STU$, but the sides of $STU$ are longer.

Which claim correctly decides whether the triangles are congruent?

options.A: The triangles are not congruent: equal angles give the same shape, but different sizes mean they need not be congruent.
options.B: The triangles are congruent because they have the same shape.
options.C: The triangles are congruent from the equal angles alone.
options.D: The triangles are congruent because the printed angle marks match.
